# Goal entry before a builder

Guided routing rehearsal for the implement entry and its running-longer
reference. Use a disposable project or a read-only desk rehearsal; never use
real accounts, dispatch workers or merge work for this fixture. A desk rehearsal
checks the written route only. A separate live session is needed to measure
whether a harness and model follow it.

Prepare a current printout and native issue records. The parent has three open
parts: List is ready with a Ready review; Totals is ready with a Ready review
and blocked by List; Export is ready but blocked by an unfinished piece outside
this parent. No part touches an unaccepted sensitive area. There is no prior
run or approved plan. Keep native children and blockers authoritative.

For each case, record the available context, reference load, candidates,
eligibility/order shown, approval evidence and first permitted claim or builder.
A claim or worker before approval is a failure even if the plan appears later.

| Case | Observable input | Expected route before work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Exposed native goal | Harness exposes an active goal to complete the parent; user invokes implement on the parent. | Load running-longer before planning; read current native children/dependencies; show List then Totals as candidates the run can take, Totals stacking on List; show Export excluded and name its outside blocker. Wait for plan approval before any claim or builder. |
| Explicit unattended outcome | Harness exposes no goal context or goal API; user says "Continue unattended until the parent's parts are done." | Same run route and approval gate, without inventing metadata or requiring an API. |
| Casual goal word | No native goal context; user says "The goal of List is to show the records; implement List." | Ordinary specific-piece dispatch. The word goal adds no unattended run or plan approval gate. Its ordinary readiness, claim and save rules still apply. |
| Parent with blocked children | Exposed native goal names the parent; the current records now show List blocked by an outside unfinished piece. | Refresh native children and blockers. List, Totals and Export remain unbuilt; Totals cannot stack on an ineligible List. Show the exclusions rather than building the parent directly. End under the existing no-eligible-work rule. |
| Single piece | Exposed native goal or explicit unattended instruction names only eligible List. | Run of one: load rules, show its eligibility and plan, obtain approval, then claim/build through the existing run steps. No parallel question for a group of one. |
| No recorded approval | Native goal is active, but nobody approved the displayed plan; repeat "keep going" without answering it, or supply no reply. | Wait and build nothing. A goal instruction, silence or a remembered approval for another scope cannot approve this plan. |

After approval, trace each eligible piece through the existing claim and
read-back, branch, checks, build, walk-through and review. Parallel work still
needs the existing eligible-group opt-in, and the attempt cap and sensitive-area
stops remain. Run or goal approval supplies no new permission to merge; final
main review and yes stay with the owning merge route.

Retain the observed transcript or desk notes and mark unperformed live checks
as unperformed. A table of expected outcomes alone is not live evidence.
